purpose: P1 standalone 2D frozen-particle scalar pressure-operator companion, not a physical solver or a production force-call regression
scope: Actual FunSphKernel.h Wendland float API; other local moments and manufactured scalars evaluated in binary64. No new framework/XML capability is implied.

geometry.volume: dp^2, uniform including analytic ghost samples
geometry.disorder: independent deterministic uint32 xorshift32 offsets in [-.15dp,.15dp], seed 20261101; IDs remain row-major reference lattice IDs
geometry.regions: core_interior excludes four reference layers on all sides; core_outer is the remaining support-complete core. Outer is NOT a physical mDBC wall or corner. Separate 9x9 no-ghost patch tests support truncation, not an implemented boundary condition.

operators.raw: 2 sum Vj(fi-fj) dij dot grad_i W/(rij^2+eta2)
operators.symC: same with .5(Ci+Cj) grad_i W, as legacy soil-soil contraction
operators.star: Each of the preceding L, minus (Gi f) dot (Li x), with common receiver-C first gradient Gi f=sum Vj(fj-fi)Ci grad_i W
operators.C: inverse of -sum Vj dij tensor grad_i W on x-z block; radial kernel makes this moment symmetric
operators.qualification: Companion transcription, not a claim to execute or match all production casts/neighbor order. The source reference hashes are retained in the runner receipt. Lian Eq25 gamma ambiguity and whole-head variant are not silently resolved by this diagnostic.

diagnostics_not_automatic_acceptance: Quadratic/mixed errors and empirical convergence are reported, with no pre-assumed second-order rate or quadratic exactness.
9x9 closed-patch volume-weighted column budget, symmetric-part largest eigenvalue, full-matrix largest-real eigenvalue and antisymmetry are reported; nonpositive spectrum is not presumed.
Pressure-only compensation plus raw gravitational-coordinate term is contrasted with whole-head compensation; no production hydrostatic or wall acceptance follows.
Observed standalone elapsed timing is not production CPU/GPU speed or whole-run overhead.
output: tests/outputs/upl_p1_scalar_r1; tests/logs/upl_p1_scalar_r1.*; runner refuses existing targets
